request.words: it is always better to split mermaid if we have it, because it takes two shots to kill her
request.context: the owner's staging game 4a48d1ca; Premium "Arrange army" split one Mermaid and spent the other spare slots on the next cheapest body, and the owner re-split by hand ("i had to resplit to what AI did")

mechanics: Mermaid (Might, level 1, 12 hp) has Water Shield: once per battle it absorbs the first incoming attack (0 damage) and breaks, and fire passes through. Every stack keeps its own shield, so a one-model Mermaid split takes two attacks to kill.
rule: In the split planner's screen mode a splittable Water Shield stack is the screen body before any other: after its reserved shield split, every spare slot becomes one more one-model split of it; slots it cannot fill go to the split-screen body (the cheapest stack not yet split). Only armies with a splittable Mermaid and spare slots change.

decision.question: How should the Mermaid rule ship?
decision.meaning: adopt for Premium "Arrange army" and the AI seats as profile v36 at once; a registered non-inferiority check runs when hosts free up, and the rule is rolled back if it fails
